name: MID
description: MID returns a specific number of characters from a text string starting at a specified position.
tldr: MID extracts characters from the middle of a text string at a specified starting position.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text string from which to extract characters.

parameters.name: start_num
parameters.description: The starting position of the extraction (1-based).

parameters.name: num_chars
parameters.description: The number of characters to extract.

basicExample.explanation: Extracts 5 characters starting from position 7 in "Hello World".

advancedExamples.title: Extract middle initial from name
advancedExamples.description: Get the middle initial from "John D. Smith"
advancedExamples.explanation: Finds the first space, then extracts one character after it.

advancedExamples.title: Extract substring between two delimiters
advancedExamples.explanation: Extracts text between the first and second dash.

howItWorks: MID starts at the specified position (1-based) and extracts the specified number of characters. Position 1 is the first character.

howToSteps.name: Select output cell
howToSteps.text: Choose where the result should appear.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The result shows the extracted text.

limitations: If start_num + num_chars exceeds the text length, MID returns as many characters as available.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: MID works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Is MID position 0-based or 1-based?
faq.answer: MID is 1-based — the first character is position 1.

faq.question: Can MID extract to the end of the string?
faq.answer: Yes, use a large num_chars value or calculate it with LEN.
